name: analysis
prohibitions: Do not claim causal effects unless a causal identification strategy is specified.
Do not treat model fit as proof of truth.
Do not interpret a 95% confidence interval as a 95% probability statement about the parameter.
required_reporting: State the estimand(s) or predictive target in plain language.
Define what a confidence interval means in repeated sampling terms.
Report effect sizes with confidence intervals, not p-values alone.
